message: Morning Christian. First thing: I owe you a correction, and it's a good one. I'd been telling you July brought in $404. Square's connector was only letting me see up to the 4th. Now that it's working properly, the real number is **$1,803.50** — $1,667.50 across the markets plus Naomi's $136 online. That's your second-best month of 2026 behind May, and you've been looking at a dashboard that showed less than a quarter of it.

What actually happened: you ran four market weekends — the 3rd-4th, 11th-12th, 17th-18th and 25th-26th — and every one of them landed. August has started slower. One market day on Sunday the 2nd, three sales, $120. Worth watching whether that's just a quiet weekend or the run cooling off.

The bills are the other real win. Back on the 12th of July you had $506 overdue and I was leading every briefing with it. Your Bills & Debts list is now clear — nothing overdue at all. What's left is subscriptions: six of them land today, $115.95 total, and ChatGPT's $30 has been sitting since yesterday.

The soft spot is the habit run. You built it on the 12th and it worked — 46 tasks that first week, 27 the next. Then 8 last week, and nothing since Saturday. Three are sitting there for today: diet, water, no screens. That's the whole ask.

One more thing — you can talk to me directly here now. The chat at the bottom reaches me with all of this in front of me. Ask me anything about the numbers, or just tell me what you've decided about the next race and I'll build the block around it.
